The '''Alsakan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Alsaka sector/Legends|Alsaka sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].
